# AvatarSample_A

The bundled `src/assets/models/AvatarSample_A.vrm` is the VRoid Project's AvatarSample_A in VRM 1.0 format. It is included for local prototype and demonstration use under the VRoid AvatarSample A–Z conditions and the embedded VRM Platform License metadata.

- Original creator: pixiv VRoid Project
- Model source: [VRMMetalKit bundled fixture](https://github.com/arkavo-org/VRMMetalKit/blob/main/AvatarSample_A_1.0.vrm.glb)
- Usage conditions: [AvatarSample A–Z](https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/ja/articles/4402394424089-AvatarSample-A-Z)
- VRM license: [VRM Public License 1.0](https://vrm.dev/licenses/1.0/)

The VRM asset has terms separate from this application's source code. The VRoid sample model may be used in applications and redistributed subject to its stated conditions; do not relicense the model as CC0.
